Subject: Rider Alert Route GGTransit Route 580 Sunday, 11/15, WB Richmond-San Rafael Bridge Closure
TextBody:
The Richmond-San Rafael Bridge will be closed in the *westbound* direction starting Saturday night, 11/14,  at 11pm  through Sunday, 11/15, at 8am.

Two westbound 580 trips will be affected on Sunday morning leaving the Del Norte Bart Station and may have a delayed arrival in San Rafael due to the detour:

*647am* trip will not serve Tewskbury, and will travel to the San Rafael Transit Center via the Bay Bridge through San Francisco.

*747am *trip will do the same as above "unless" the bridge has reopened by that time. If that is the case, the route will proceed as usual to the San Rafael Transit Center. 

580 eastbound trips will not be affected. 

-----

For trip-planning assistance, call 511/415-455-2000 (say "Golden Gate Transit," or "Golden Gate Ferry" then "operator" to bypass recorded messages)/TDD 711. Customer service representatives are available weekdays from 7:00 am to 6:00 pm.
